21046.title: THALMANN AND COLERAIN 23O KV LINE RELAY PANEL UPGRADES
21046.desc: Relay protection modifications at GPC's Thalmann and Colerain substations to match relay scheme used at GTC's new Camden Industrial Park 230/115kV substation.

20326.title: ANTHONY SHOALS STATCOM SYSTEM
20326.desc: Install a + 150 / - 150 MVAR turnkey STATCOM system at Anthony Shoals 230kV substation.

17075.title: SAV: LITTLE OGEECHEE 230-115KV: RELAY MODERNIZATION
17075.desc: Relay modernization with conversion of the 230kV ring bus to BAAH topology and addition of BAAH rung for Big Ogeechee - Little Ogeechee (Red) 230kV Line. Rebuild 115kV straight bus to BAAH design.

20491.title: EAST POINT RELAY MODERNIZATION
20491.desc: Upgrade protection on 230kV buses, 115kV buses, and 230/115kV auto transformer at the East Point station. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply.

20474.title: GRADY 230/115KV RELAY MODERNIZATION
20474.desc: Upgrade protection on 230kV bus, all 115kV buses, and both 230/115kV auto transformers at Grady. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply. Install a 230kV breaker and associated switches on the high side of Grady 230/115kV auto transformer D.

20490.title: KLONDIKE RELAY MODERNIZATION
20490.desc: Upgrade protection on 230kV buses at the Klondike station. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply.

20300.title: MORROW 115KV RELAY UPGRADE
20300.desc: Upgrade protection scheme on all three 115kV buses at Morrow.

20489.title: SCOTTDALE RELAY MODERNIZATION
20489.desc: Upgrade protection on 230kV bus and 230/115kV auto transformers at the Scottdale station. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply.

20668.title: DRESDEN LINE PROTECTIVE RELAYING
20668.desc: On the O'Hara - Wansley 500kV line, replace the protective relay panels associated with the 500kV line terminal facing Dresden, at both O'Hara and Wansley.

18832.title: MEAG: FORTSON SUBSTATION MODERNIZATION
18832.desc: Complete modernization and replacement of obsolete equipment and relays for the 500kV, 230kV, and 115kV yards. Add a redundant relay scheme at Fortson.

21022.title: OHARA BREAKER REPLACEMENT
21022.desc: Replace Breaker on the Ohara - Tara 115kV Line at the Ohara Substation.

20277.title: SAV: MCINTOSH - PURRYSBURG 230KV REACTORS
20277.desc: Install reactors on the McIntosh - Purrysburg (Black and White) 230kV tie lines at McIntosh. Rebuild 0.1 miles (GPC portion) for both lines to (2) 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

21111.title: GTC: HARTWELL DAM - HARTWELL ENERGY 230KV SERIES REACTORS
21111.desc: GTC: Replace the 1600A series reactors on the Hartwell Dam - Hartwell Energy 230kV line with 3000A.

21113.title: GTC: HARTWELL ENERGY - MIDDLE FORK 230KV LINE
21113.desc: Construct a new 230kV line, approx. 35 miles, from Hartwell Energy to Middle Fork with 200C (2) 1351 ACSS conductor. GTC: Expand Hartwell Energy 230kV and Middle Fork 230kV as necessary to install breakers to accept new line termination.

19523.title: SAV: CC - HYUNDAI MOTORS SAVANNAH AKA. PROJECT EA
19523.desc: Construct a new Hyundai 230kV substation with an eight element 230kV ring bus and four 230/25kV banks. Construct a new Newton Rd 230kV substation with a five element 230kV ring bus and loop through the Little Ogeechee - Meldrim Black and White 230kV lines. Build two new 230kV lines connecting from Hyundai - Newton Rd (12 miles) and Hyundai - Meldrim (10 miles). At Meldrim, add a breaker to accommodate for the new Hyundai line. Install a 115/25kV bank at Interstate Centre and build a new 115kV line from Interstate Centre - Hyundai (2.3 miles) for bridge power.

18670.title: GTC: BANKS CROSSING - POND FORK 115 KV
18670.desc: GTC will build a new 115kV line from McClure Industrial to structure 21N on the Ridgeway Church Road Junction or tap point (approximately 3 miles). Close normally open switch at Ridgeway Church Road to establish the Banks Crossing - Pond Fork 115kV line. All new conductors should be 100C 1351 ACSR Martin.

18492.title: MITCHELL - NORTH TIFTON 230KV RECONDUCTOR
18492.desc: Rebuild 35.21 miles of the Mitchell - North Tifton 230kV line from 100C 795 ACSR to 100C 1351 ACSR.

19676.title: ADAMSVILLE - JACK MCDONOUGH 230KV LINE REBUILD
19676.desc: Rebuild the entire 6.1 mile Adamsville - Jack McDonough 230kV line with 160C 1351 ACSS.

18800.title: ECHECONNEE-WELLSTON 115KV REBUILD
18800.desc: Rebuild the South Warner Robins to Wellston section (1.2 miles) with 100C 1351.5 ACSR Martin conductor.

19187.title: GRID - BREMEN - CROOKED CREEK (APC) 115 KV PROJECT
19187.desc: Rebuild from Bremen to Indian Creek Road, on the Bremen - Crooked Creek 115kV line (14 miles), using 795 ACSR conductor at 100C.

18153.title: GTC: BONAIRE PRI-ECHECONNEE 115 KV PARTIAL REBUILD
18153.desc: Rebuild 2.3 miles of the Bonaire Primary - Echeconnee 115kV line with 100C ACSR 795 conductor.

20342.title: GTC: CAMDEN INDUSTRIAL PARK 230/115KV NEW SUBSTATION
20342.desc: GTC will construct a new 230/115kV substation with a three element 230kV ring bus, two element 115kV ring bus, and one new 230/115kV 400MVA transformer. A new 115kV line to Kinlaw substation will be built also.

20590.title: GTC: EATONTON PRIMARY - LICK CREEK 115KV LINE SWITCH REPLACEMENT
20590.desc: Replace a 1200A RLB line switch on the Eatonton - Lake Oconee 115kV line with a with motor operator and SCADA controls. This switch is located on GTC's Eatonton Primary - Lick Creek 115kV section of the Eatonton Primary - Lake Oconee 115kV Line.

11821.title: JESUP - LUDOWICI PRIMARY 115KV REBUILD
11821.desc: Rebuild approximately 7.5 miles of the Jesup - North Jesup - Rayonier section of the Jesup - Ludowici Primary 115kV line from 100C 336.4 ACSR Linnet conductor to 100C 795 ACSR Drake conductor.

13753.title: MEAG: ALCOVY ROAD - SKC 115 KV RECONDUCTOR
13753.desc: MEAG will reconductor approximately 0.53 miles of 100C 336 ACSR conductor with 100C 1033 ACSR conductor from Alcovy Road to Alcovy Road Jct. on the Alcovy Road - SKC 115kV line.

13787.title: MEAG: AULTMAN ROAD - BONAIRE PRIMARY 115 KV REBUILD
13787.desc: MEAG: Rebuild approximately 1.99 miles of Sleepy Hollow - Peach Blossom 115kV section of the Aultman Road - Bonaire Primary 115kV line from 100C 336 ACSR to 100C 795 ACSR. GTC: Replace the jumpers at Sleepy Hollow with 1590 AAC.

20464.title: NORCROSS 230KV BUS 1-3 SERIES BUS TIE BREAKER INSTALLATION
20464.desc: Install a bus tie breaker in series with existing bus tie breaker between 230kV Bus 1 and Bus 3 at Norcross.

19631.title: PINE GROVE PRIMARY 115 KV DUAL STAGE CAPACITOR BANK
19631.desc: Install a Dual Stage 30MVAR capacitor bank at Pine Grove Primary.

20067.title: SAV: DEPTFORD - MAGNOLIA 115KV RECONDUCTOR
20067.desc: Reconductor the Deptford - Magnolia 115kV line (approximately 5 miles) using 973.1 C7 ACCS (Everglades) conductor and upgrade the Deptford main bus.

20466.title: SMART VALVE INSTALLATION
20466.desc: Installation of Smart Valve devices inside the Eatonton Primary substation on the Branch - Oasis 230kV and Eatonton Primary - Oasis 230kV lines.

20431.title: VILLA RICA LOW SIDE BREAKER
20431.desc: Replace a low side breaker at Villa Rica with a 4000A breaker.

20684.title: CAMDEN INDUSTRIAL PARK (GPC)
20684.desc: This project will loop in GPC's existing Colerain to Thalman 230kV line into GTC's new Camden Industrial Park station. GPC's Kingsland termination at GTC's Kinlaw sub will be relocated to a new 115kV bay position.

18774.title: GTC: HEARD COUNTY - TENASKA 500KV (SECOND LINE)
18774.desc: GTC: Build a second Heard County - Tenaska 500kV line, 0.8 miles, with 100C (3) 1113 ACSR Bluejay conductors. Add a 500kV breaker at Heard County. GPC: Add a 500kV breaker at Tenaska.

18889.title: JEFFERSON STREET#3 - NORTHWEST (WHITE) 115 KV RECONDUCTOR
18889.desc: Rebuild the 115kV White line from Northwest to Jefferson Street #3 (1.2 miles) with 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

20152.title: CC - CASS PINE- HILL VIEW 230 KV LINE- CC IMPROVEMENTS
20152.desc: Build a new 7.58 mile 200C 1351 ACSS conductor 230kV line between new Cass Pine and Hill View 230kV substations.

20175.title: CC - PROJECT CHRONOS- SK/HYUNDAI
20175.desc: GPC will build a 230/25kV station named Two Run Ranch and loop it into the Cartersville - Pinson 230kV line to serve SK Battery/Hyundai and new load in the area.

20010.title: GTC: ANTHONY SHOALS - WASHINGTON 115 KV LINE REBUILD
20010.desc: Rebuild 21 miles of the Double Branches Junction - Washington 115kV line section with 100C 795 ACSR conductor or higher rated conductor.

18691.title: GTC: LIZARD LOPE - WESTOVER 115 KV NEW LINE
18691.desc: Construct two new 115kV stations, Lizard Lope and Westover, and build a new 19.8 miles of 115kV line from Lizard Lope to Gillionville

20018.title: CC - QTS FAYETTEVILLE TRANSMISSION NEEDS
20018.desc: Build a new 500/230kV substation (Ashley Park) splitting the Ohara - Union City 500kV line. Install two 500/230kV auto transformers at the Ashley Park station. At Ashley Park, the 500kV side will be a 4 - breaker ring bus, while the 230kV side will be a 2 - rung Breaker and a Half configuration. Build two new 230kV lines (~6 miles each) from Ashley Park to the high side of customer substations. The new lines will be built with bundled 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor.

19597.title: ADAMSVILLE - BUZZARD ROOST 230KV REBUILD AND JUMPER UPGRADE
19597.desc: Rebuild the line sections from Adamsville to Boat Rock Road (8.08 miles) on the Adamsville - Buzzard Roost 230kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor. Replace the AAC 750 jumper on the line at Adamsville with (2) 1590 AAC jumper. Replace 1590 AAC jumpers at Bakers Ferry and Boat Rock with (2) 1590 AAC jumpers. Replace 1600A line switches at Boat Rock with 3000A switches.

18960.title: BLANKETS CREEK – WOODSTOCK 115KV LINE REBUILD
18960.desc: Rebuild the entire Blankets Creek - Woodstock 115kV line, approximately 7.1 miles, with 200C 795 ACSS conductor.

20243.title: CC - GARRETT ROAD SWITCHING STATION - TRAE LANE
20243.desc: Build the new Garrett Road 230kV switching station (three - element ring bus) splitting the Villa Rica - West Marietta 230kV line. Build a new 230kV line (8.6 miles) from the Trae Lane substation to the Garrett Road switching station with bundled 100C 1351 ACSR conductor.

20216.title: CC - STONEWALL TELL ROAD (TA REALTY)
20216.desc: Build 230kV line segment, using 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor, to loop in the Stonewall Tell Road (TA Realty) customer station into the East Point - Union City 230kV Black line.

18679.title: DU: EAST DALTON - OOSTANAULA 115KV REBUILD
18679.desc: DU: Rebuild the portion of East Dalton - Oostanaula and Dalton - East Dalton 115kV double circuit lines between East Dalton substation and the Dalton substation frame with 200C 795 ACSS.

16007.title: FENWICK STREET - SAND BAR FERRY 115KV (RECONDUCTOR/REBUILD)
16007.desc: Reconductor approximately 2.72 miles of transmission line from Fenwick St to East Augusta Jct. with 100C 1351 ACSR conductor.

20516.title: GOAT ROCK 230KV SWITCH, JUMPER, & LINE TRAP REPLACEMENT
20516.desc: Replace the 230kV 1200A switch with 3000A, 90C 1351.5 ACSR Martin jumper with (2) AAC 1590, and 1600A line trap with 3000A (part of the Goat Rock - North Opelika 230kV line at Goat Rock substation.

19618.title: GORDON-N DUBLIN 115KV (GORDON-ENGL MCI J) REBUILD
19618.desc: Rebuild the Gordon - Engelhard McIntyre J of the Gordon - North Dublin 115kV line from 100C 336.4 ACSR (2.81 miles) Linnet and 75C 4/0 F Copper/CW (3.18 miles) to 200C ACSS 795 conductor.

21139.title: GRADY - MORROW (WHITE) 115KV REBUILD
21139.desc: Replace 0.72 miles of conductor from Moreland Way to Morrow including the bus and jumper at Moreland Way with 1351.5 Martin/ACSS 54/19 conductor.

19706.title: GRID - GAINESVILLE #2 EQUIPMENT REPLACEMENT
19706.desc: GPC: Replace the two 230/115kV auto transformers (Bank C and D) at Gainesville #2 with 400MVA. Project was originally maintenance driven but now compliance driven.

21137.title: GTC: CONYERS - CORNISH MOUNTAIN 115KV LINE UPGRADE
21137.desc: Upgrade 750 jumpers at North Conyers and raise the temperature rating of the 636 ACSR conductor on the Conyers - Cornish MTN 115kV line from 100C to 125C.

19334.title: GTC: LAGRANGE - NORTH OPELIKA 230 KV
19334.desc: Build a new Lagrange - North Opelika (APC) 230kV line, 29.4 miles, with 100C ACSR 1351.5 Martin Conductor. GTC will construct the ~15 - mile section from Lagrange to the Metering Station near the Georgia - Alabama border. The Metering Station will be owned by GTC. GPC will construct the short line section from the Metering Station to the GA - AL state line. APC will construct the 230kV line from the GA - AL state line to North Opelika.

20015.title: GTC: MORNING HORNET 2ND 230/115 KV BANK & THUMBS UP 115KV TL
20015.desc: GTC to add a second 230/115kV auto transformer at Morning Hornet substation. Also, build an additional 115kV line from Morning Hornet to Thumbs Up, approximately 2.4 miles, using at least 100C 1351 ACSR conductor.

19999.title: GTC: ROBINS SPRING BUS REPLACEMENT
19999.desc: GTC: Replace the main 115kV bus 90C ACSR 336.4 Linnet conductor with higher rating.

20001.title: GTC: ROBINS SPRING CAPACITOR BANK INSTALLATION
20001.desc: Install a 115kV 2 - stage 22.5MVAR (45MVAR total) capacitor bank at Robins Spring

19636.title: HAMMOND - WEISS DAM 115KV LINE REBUILD
19636.desc: Rebuild 11.2 miles of Hammond - Weiss Dam 115kV from Hammond to the APC border with 200C 795 ACSS.

20512.title: KATHLEEN AREA IMPROVEMENTS
20512.desc: Rebuild the Kathleen - Big Grocery Creek 230kV line (approximately 1.5 miles). Rebuild the Bonaire Primary - Kathleen 230kV line (approximately 6 miles). Upgrade limiting elements at Kathleen substation.

19598.title: MEAG: DRESDEN - LAGRANGE PRIMARY 230KV UPGRADE & JUMPERS
19598.desc: MEAG will re-sag the Dresden - LaGrange Primary 230kV line to 125C. Replace the jumpers at Dresden and LaGrange with (2) 1590 AAC jumpers.

20270.title: MEAG: RAY PLACE RD - WASHINGTON #3
20270.desc: Rebuild the Ray Place Rd - Washington 115kV line with 100C 795 ACSR conductor (total 17.4 Miles) between Ray Place Rd and Washington 2. Replace Jumpers and bus at Washington 2.

20271.title: MEAG: RAY PLACE RD - WASHINGTON (WASHINGTON - WASHINGTON 3)
20271.desc: MEAG will rebuild the Ray Place Rd - Washington 115kV line with 100C 1351 ACSR conductor (total 1.2 Miles) between Washington and Washington 3. Replace jumpers at Washington.

18690.title: PALMYRA REACTOR REMOVAL
18690.desc: Remove the 6% reactor at the Palmyra Substation.

20066.title: SAV: BOULEVARD - DEPTFORD 115KV RECONDUCTOR
20066.desc: Reconductor the Boulevard - Deptford 115kV line (approximately 8 miles) using 973.1 C7 ACCS (Everglades) conductor. Upgrade main bus and jumpers at Bolton substation from 90C 1590 AAC Coreopsis to 90C (2)1590 AAC Coreopsis or higher rated equipment.

19966.title: SAV: CC - BIG OGEECHEE 500/230KV (CC NETWORK IMPROVEMENTS)
19966.desc: Construct a new substation near Little Ogeechee, adjacent to the 500kV and 230kV shared right of way for McCall Road - Thalmann 500kV and the Little Ogeechee - Meldrim 230kV Black and White lines. The new substation will loop in the existing McCall Road - Thalmann 500kV line, the existing Little Ogeechee - Meldrim 230kV lines, and accommodate a new 1344MVA 500/230kV auto transformers with an additional 230kV connection to Little Ogeechee.

17900.title: UNION CITY - YATES 230 KV WHITE LINE REBUILD
17900.desc: Rebuild 23.4 miles of the Union City - Yates 230kV White line with bundled 1351 ACSS Martin conductor at 200C.

20691.title: UNION CITY - YATES 230KV (WHITE) SWITCH AND TRAP REPLACEMENT
20691.desc: Replace the limiting elements at Union City and Yates substations along the Union City - Yates 230kV (White) line.

20223.title: CC - PROJECT PAYTON BAINBRIDGE
20223.desc: Split Farley - South Bainbridge 230kV line with a 230kV station (Dothan Road) and bring an 8.5 mile 200C 1351 ACSS 230kV line from Dothan Rd to new customer sub Downrange. Bring another 10mile 200C 1351 ACSS 230kV line from Climax to customer sub Downrange.

20874.title: GTC: BARNESVILLE PRIMARY-BARNESVILLE #1 115KV RECONDUCTOR
20874.desc: Rebuild approximately 4.53 miles of the Barnesville Primary - Barnesville #1 segment on the Barnesville Primary - Lamar County Industrial 115kV line.

20273.title: GTC: DRESDEN 500KV BUS EXPANSION
20273.desc: GTC will expand the Dresden 500kV bus into a 5 - element ring bus configuration. Loop the O'Hara - Wansley 500kV line into the Dresden 500kV substation and allow for future Dresden - Talbot 500kV line termination.

20002.title: GTC: GORDON - SANDERSVILLE #1 115KV LINE REBUILD
20002.desc: Rebuild the 1.87 miles of Sandersville #1 - Sandersville #6 line section of the Gordon - Sandersville #1 115kV line from 100C ACSR 336 conductor to 100C ACSR 795 conductor.

20151.title: CC - CASS PINE 230/25 NEW SUB - QCELLS - CC IMPROVEMENTS
20151.desc: Build a new 230/25kV 8 element ring bus networked substation named Cass Pine that will interconnect between new Great Valley and Hill View 230kV substations.

19287.title: GRADY-WEST END 115KV REBUILD
19287.desc: Reconductor the Grady - West End 115kV line (2.6 miles) using 200C 1351 ACSS Martin.

19363.title: MORROW - MOUNTAIN VIEW 115 KV REBUILD
19363.desc: Rebuild the Mountain View - Barnett Road section of the Morrow - Mountain View 115kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor.

20509.title: CC - EMBLEM RIVERSIDE CUSTOMER SUB (FLEXENTIAL)
20509.desc: A new customer substation, Emblem Riverside, is being built along the Buzzard Roost - Douglasville 230kV line. Moreover, a Fiber ICON ring is being built in the area to help with communications and protection for all customers in the area.

19635.title: GTC: HICKORY LEVEL - VILLA RICA 230KV LINE RECONDUCTOR

21118.title: MEAG: ATHENA - WARRENTON 230KV CONVERSION
21118.desc: Reconductor/rebuild and convert the 115kV lines from Athena - Union Point - Ray Place Road - Warrenton Primary to 230kV operation. Expand Athena 230kV bus for new line termination, construct 230kV bus at Union Point, and expand 230kV bus at Warrenton Primary for new line termination. Install 230/115kV auto transformers at Union Point Primary and Ray Place Road. Replace limiting network equipment at substations along the line.

20857.title: NEW CAVENDER DRIVE - TRIBUTARY 230KV LINE
20857.desc: Build a new 4 mile 230kV line from Cavender Drive to Tributary with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin.

21093.title: NORTH SPA 230KV STRATEGIC PROJECT
21093.desc: This project includes the following scope of work: Build a new 230kV switching station north of Oasis in a ring bus configuration with 4 - breakers. Loop in the East Social Circle - Oasis (White) 230kV line. Build a new 230kV line to Cornish Mountain from North Spa. New 230kV line from Rockville 230kV will terminate in this station.

19995.title: TALLULAH LODGE - TOCCOA 115 KV REBUILD
19995.desc: Rebuild the Tallulah Lodge - Toccoa 115kV Line with 100C 795 ACSR conductor (total of 10.3 miles). Replace limiting elements at Tallulah Lodge and Toccoa.

21098.title: TRIBUTARY - THORNTON RD 230KV REBUILD
21098.desc: Rebuild the 2.8 mile Tributary - Thornton Road 230kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin.

20160.title: THOMASTON 230 NEW BUILD SUB
20160.desc: Replace Thomaston 230/115kV 285MVA auto transformers C and D with 400MVA auto transformers. Install high side breakers to meet the 230kV bus differential standards and redesign 230kV bus to a breaker and a half configuration.

18848.title: BAINBRIDGE TRANSMISSION: EAST RIVER ROAD, EAST BAINBRIDGE
18848.desc: This project will construct a new 115kV breaker and a half substation a mile north of the East Bainbridge substation. East Bainbridge will be simplified to a 115kV straight bus with two transmission lines for service to load, a generation interconnection point and a capacitor bank.

19626.title: GLENWOOD SPRINGS 115KV CAP BANK
19626.desc: Install a 115kV two stage 30MVAR capacitor bank at Glenwood Springs substation.

20690.title: EAST POINT - UNION CITY (WHITE) 230KV REBUILD
20690.desc: Rebuild 5.49 miles of 100C 1590.0 ACSR Lapwing with 200C 1351.5 ACSS Martin 230kV line from Welcome All to Union City on the East Point - Union City 230kV line.

19632.title: AVERY - HOPEWELL 115KV RECONDUCTOR
19632.desc: Reconductor the Hopewell to Birmingham line section (approximately 3.3 miles) on the Avery - Hopewell 115kV line with 100C 1033 ACSR conductor. Replace jumper at Birmingham with 1590 AAC jumper.

10811.title: BOWEN #10 500/230KV AUTOBANK REPLACEMENT
10811.desc: Replace the existing Bowen #10 1350 MVA 500/230kV auto transformer with a 2016 MVA 500/230kV auto transformer.

20756.title: HATCH - WADLEY 500 KV LINE STRATEGIC PROJECT
20756.desc: Construct a new 500kV line from Hatch - Wadley Primary.

21099.title: MEAG: PIO NONO 230/115KV AREA SOLUTION
21099.desc: Build a 4 - breaker 230kV ring bus to terminate lines from Dorsett, South Griffin, and Big Grocery. Install a 400MVA auto transformer and build a 115kV yard to terminate a line from Broadway. Make all necessary modifications to accommodate all the 230kV and 115kV lines terminations.

21114.title: MEAG: SOUTH GRIFFIN 230/115KV BANK #5
21114.desc: Replace 230/115kV 285MVA auto transformer #5 with 230/115kV 400MVA auto transformer at South Griffin.

20784.title: SAV: COLEMAN - MELDRIM 115KV LINE REBUILD
20784.desc: Rebuild 3 miles of the Coleman - Meldrim 115kV line from Four Lakes to Meldrim with 200C 1351 ACSS.

20767.title: ARKWRIGHT BUS AND JUMPER REPLACEMENT
20767.desc: Replace the 115kV bus at Arkwright with higher rating and replace the jumper on the Arkwright - Forrest Rd (Macon) 115kV line with at least 1590AAC.

20758.title: BAY CREEK - CONYERS 230KV LIMITING ELEMENT REPLACEMENT
20758.desc: Replace equipment such as jumpers, switches, and traps at the Bay Creek, Rockdale, and Conyers substations with equipment capable of carrying 3000A.

20793.title: EVANS PRIMARY - THURMOND DAM (USA) #5 115KV REBUILD
20793.desc: Rebuild approximately 5.45 miles of Euchee Creek - Thurmond Dam segment of the Evans Primary - Thurmond Dam (USA) #5 115kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor. Replace the main bus with a larger element at Thurmond Dam (USA).

20794.title: EVANS PRIMARY - THURMOND DAM (USA) #6 115KV REBUILD
20794.desc: Rebuild approximately 8.9 miles of the Evans Primary - Thurmond Dam (USA) #6 115kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor. Replace the main bus with a larger element at Thurmond Dam (USA).

12217.title: GTC: CENTER PRIMARY - CLARKSBORO 230 KV REBUILD
12217.desc: GTC to rebuild the Center Primary – Clarksboro Primary 230kV line (approx. 8.3 miles) with 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

20773.title: GTC: CLARKSBORO - WINDER PRIMARY 230KV REBUILD
20773.desc: Rebuild approximately 14 miles of the Clarksboro - Winder 230kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

12147.title: GTC: EAST SOCIAL CIRCLE - SNELLVILLE 230KV EQUIPMENT UPGRADE
12147.desc: Replace the 1200A switches at Snellville Primary with 3000A. Also, replace the 1200A line trap and switches at East Social Circle with 3000A on the East Social Circle - Snellville 230kV line.

21075.title: GTC: EAST WALTON - MIDDLE FORK 500KV
21075.desc: Construct a new 500kV line from East Walton to Middle Fork, approximately 45 miles long. Make all necessary accommodations for new 500kV breakers at East Walton and Middle Fork substations.

20791.title: GTC: SHOAL CREEK - SOUTH HALL 230KV REBUILD
20791.desc: Rebuild approximately 7.9 miles of South Hall - Chestnut Mountain - Spout Springs Road segments of the Shoal Creek - South Hall 230kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS conductor. Also, replace 1 - AAC 1590 jumpers at South Hall with 2 - AAC 1590.

21053.title: MCEVER ROAD - SHOAL CREEK 115KV REBUILD
21053.desc: Rebuild the 2 - 4/0 copper part (approximately 2.9 miles) of the Gainesville Ferry - Lakeside WTP A line section, part of the McEver Road - Shoal Creek 115kV line, using 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

09661.title: MCGRAU FORD - MIDDLE FORK 500KV LINE PROJECT
09661.desc: Construct a new approximately 64 mile 500kV line from McGrau Ford to Middle Fork.

20796.title: SAV: MELDRIM BANK D REPLACEMENT
20796.desc: Replace 300 MVA 230/115kV Bank D with 400 MVA Bank.

14222.title: THOMSON PRIMARY 230/115KV SECOND TRANSFORMER
14222.desc: Install a second 400 MVA, 230/115kV auto transformer at Thomson Primary substation.

20759.title: WINDER PRIMARY 230KV BUS 1-2 PARALLEL BUS-TIE INSTALLATION
20759.desc: Install a 2nd 230kV bus - tie breaker at the Winder Primary Station.

10487.title: PINE GROVE PRIMARY - WEST VALDOSTA 115 KV RECONDUCTOR
10487.desc: Rebuild 3.7 miles of 100C 4/0 ACSR conductor with 200C 795 ACSS Drake on the Bemis - Pine Grove Primary section of the Pine Grove Primary - West Valdosta 115kV line.

18700.title: DAWSON CROSSING - GAINESVILLE #1 115 KV
18700.desc: Replace the 500CU main bus at Gainesville #1 115kV with 3" Sch 40 AL Tube.

20787.title: SAV: LITTLE OGEECHEE 230/115KV BANK REPLACEMENT
20787.desc: Replace SATX 280MVA auto transformer with 400MVA auto transformer.

17993.title: EVANS PRIMARY - THOMSON PRIMARY 115KV REBUILD
17993.desc: Rebuild the existing 100C 336 ACSR conductor for the Thomson Primary to Pumpkin Center 115kV line section (approximately 5.28 miles), part of the Evans Primary - Thomson Primary 115kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor.
